description: This file defines an interface `CommandsTopicPathBuilder` in the package `org.eclipse.ditto.protocoladapter`. The interface provides methods to build command topic paths with different actions such as create, retrieve, modify, and delete, likely for use in a messaging or pub/sub system within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: CommandsTopicPathBuilder
classes.description: An interface for building command topic paths with methods to set actions like create, retrieve, modify, and delete.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Sets the action of the builder to CREATE, replacing any previously set action. Returns the builder for chaining.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Sets the action of the builder to RETRIEVE, replacing any previously set action. Returns the builder for chaining.

methods.name: modify
methods.description: Sets the action of the builder to MODIFY, replacing any previously set action. Returns the builder for chaining.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Sets the action of the builder to DELETE, replacing any previously set action. Returns the builder for chaining.
